title: Senior Business Growth & Partnerships Manager – Italy
motivazione: Senior Business Growth & Partnerships Manager nella banca digitale BBVA: pipeline di opportunità, business case con impatto P&L, negoziazione di partnership e brand building con il marketing. Hai P&L, go-to-market e lo spirito imprenditoriale. Gap: 5+ anni di BD e partnership preferibilmente in banking o fintech, e il tedesco è solo 'molto gradito' (sconto, non blocco).
testo_completo: Excited to grow your career? BBVA is a global company with more than 160 years of history that operates in more than 25 countries where we serve more than 80 million customers. We are more than 121,000 professionals working in multidisciplinary teams with profiles as diverse as financiers, legal experts, data scientists, developers, engineers and designers. The Global Digital Banks unit has established a strategic Business Development & Partnerships function focused on identifying, developing, and launching new business opportunities—both financial and non-financial—through strategic alliances with third parties. The team aims to maximize P&L impact, accelerate customer acquisition, and strengthen BBVA's brand positioning in key digital banking markets, particularly Italy and Germany. This cross-functional role combines strategic vision, commercial expertise, and execution capabilities to develop innovative, scalable business models and partnerships that deliver measurable business results. About the job: This cross-functional role combines strategic vision, commercial expertise, and execution capabilities to develop innovative, scalable business models and partnerships that deliver measurable business results. Key Responsibilities 1. Business Development & Growth Opportunities Identify and develop new business opportunities through market analysis, customer insights, emerging trends, and potential strategic partners. Explore opportunities to scale existing Group partnerships into new markets. Build and prioritize a pipeline of high-impact opportunities aligned with business objectives and customer needs. 2. Strategic Analysis & Business Case Development Assess the strategic, financial, and operational viability of new opportunities, developing business cases with clear P&L impact, scalability, and time-to-market considerations. Define innovative business models and value propositions in collaboration with internal teams and external partners. Ensure alignment with customer needs, market positioning, and competitive differentiation. 3. Strategic Partnerships & Negotiation Identify, engage, and build long-term relationships with strategic partners. Lead partnership negotiations, defining commercial, financial, contractual, and operational collaboration frameworks. Structure mutually beneficial agreements that maximize business value and support sustainable growth. 4. Execution & Implementation Lead the end-to-end implementation of new business initiatives, from opportunity validation to operational launch. Coordinate cross-functional teams, including Legal, Compliance, Technology, Marketing, Procurement, and Operations. Establish governance models, milestones, and KPIs to ensure timely execution and measurable results. Ensure a smooth transition to Business as Usual (BAU) operations. 5. Brand Building & Strategic Visibility Identify and execute strategic partnerships, sponsorships, and brand-building initiatives to strengthen BBVA's awareness and positioning in new markets. Collaborate with Marketing and Communications teams to deliver impactful campaigns and initiatives. Measure commercial and reputational impact, identifying opportunities for optimization. 6. Partnership Management & Performance Act as a key relationship manager for strategic partners, fostering trust and long-term collaboration. Monitor partnership performance, business impact, and KPIs, identifying opportunities for growth and improvement. Drive the continuous evolution of existing partnerships through new business opportunities and collaboration models. Required Experience & Skills Minimum 5 years of proven experience in Business Development and Strategic Partnerships, preferably in banking, financial services, fintech, or digital businesses. Languages: Fluency in Italian and English is required (both written and spoken). Proficiency in German is highly desirable. Demonstrated track record in identifying, negotiating, and executing strategic partnerships and commercial agreements. Strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and ability to develop business cases with measurable financial impact. Experience managing complex, cross-functional projects from concept to implementation. Results-oriented mindset, with strong analytical capabilities and a proactive, entrepreneurial approach. Ability to operate effectively in dynamic, international, and fast-paced environments. Skills: Empatía, Ética, Innovación, Orientación al cliente, Pensamiento proactivo Compensation: From: 60,000 EUR The salary stated above is indicative and corresponds to the annual fixed salary associated with the position. In addition, the following shall apply: The variable remuneration scheme established by the Bank and in force from time to time, designed to recognise individual performance and contribution to the collective achievements of both the Bank and the relevant business unit, in accordance with the applicable criteria and internal policies. The employee benefits made available to staff from time to time. Any other salary components, allowances or supplementary payments that may apply pursuant to the applicable Collective Bargaining Agreement, internal policies, or the specific conditions of the role and the successful candidate.
